message: Actual prepare-stage recovery/replay gap: root-prepare-replay-new-run-probe.json at source98247a... loses the first S3 PUT response after it reaches the synthetic service, restores the original pre-prepare archive, then uses an authenticated NEW run456/session sdd-456. Second prepare returns PASS and mutations are PutObject,PutObject,CreateChangeSet. Original root-prepare-replay-probe.json's new-run BLOCKED was ONLY fixture hardcoding (run123 URLs/RoleSessionName); the corrected probe explicitly validates new456 identities then adapts those fixture assertions. Preserve both, do not claim the first proves protection. Also reconcile currently rejects publish/create submission paths, so prepare uncertainty cannot be queried through the public readonly recovery path. Cover prepare mutations as well as Execute: add genuine committed Red with real new-run fixture support, fence/reconcile uncertain publication and Change Set creation without blind repeat writes, preserve exact S3 key/version when known or original scoped Change Set name/ARN/token, and keep missing native history UNKNOWN. Read-only recovery must never auto-publish/create/execute; explicit safe handling of a previous complete immutable asset is distinct from blindly uploading another version. No generic state store/cloud actions. This is approved replay/partial-prepare recovery scope, not an independent verdict.
